Commentary.Commentary: Rashid Khan, the man of the moment, is being interviewed near the ropes - Says he is always happy to do well for his team. Admits it is a crucial match as it's the series decider. States that he focused on doing the basis right and keep the balls in good areas. Reckons it's a turning wicket. Feels that they did not bowl well in the last match and mentions that even today they were not at their best. However, feels they hit the good length areas much more today and that reaped them the rewards. Ends by saying that they hope to play positive cricket, to have fun while playing, give 100% effort and not care much about the result.

The target is a very small one and one would back the Afghan players to chase this down. The wicket is a little slow and there is some turn on offer but Ireland are probably 50 to 60 runs short. So what do we have in store for you in the second innings? Afghanistan making a mockery of the run chase or Ireland fighting back? Join us to find out.

Ireland just never recovered after that. Rashid Khan then ran through the middle order. Wilson and McBrine's partnership did look like it would give the Irish scorecard some respectability but Afghanistan broke through from an unlikely source. Their skipper, Afghan, yes you read it right, Asghar Afghan, got rid of Wilson and the last three wickets fell in no time.

So that ends an excellent bowling performance by Afghanistan. Exactly what they would have wished for after being asked to field. It was Alam who started off everything as he got Stirling early. Porterfield and Balbirnie then, did start building a partnership but a few rash shots saw Ireland lose three wickets in quick succession.

OUT! It looked like a six till the very end but Gulbadin at deep long on pouches a skier. Rankin sees the flight on this one which is floated full on the off stump by Nabi. The southpaw swings through the line towards long on. The ball goes high up in the air towards long on and for a moment it looks like it will sail over the ropes. But Naib positioned there judges it well, settles under the ball nicely and wraps up the innings.
Very full outside off, the batsman jams it out to covers.
Eases this down to long on for a run. All these are handy runs for Ireland.
On off, strokes to covers.
The googly on off, Rankin tries to defend but gets beaten.
Flatter on middle, Rankin tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Close! Quick and it is the leggie outside off, Rankin somehow gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Tossed up full outside off, Chase shoulders arms.

FOUR! Streaky, but the home team will not mind. Nabi bowls a beauty again as it pitches on off and skids on. Chase looks to block it lunging forward. The ball kisses his outside edge but flies through the slips region. No Slip, Not good by Afghanistan. The hosts get four more.
Peter Chase is the next batsman in.
OUT c Aftab Alam b Mohammad Nabi. Ireland have lost their ninth wicket.
Gets behind the line of this shortish delivery on off and blocks it out.
Tossed up ball on off, McBrine leans forward and defends.
A bit slower and straighter on his pads, flicks this one into the square leg region for a single.

FOUR! Out comes the broom and earns him a boundary after 14 overs. McBrine gets down on his knees to this fuller ball on the stumps, sweeps this and gets this right from the middle of the bat. Finds the gap at deep square leg and the ball runs across the ropes.
Slower and a bit shorter is defended off the back foot.
Tries the flick again, misses and gets hit on the pads. No appeal this time.

McBrine tries to whip this flatter one into the leg side, gets beaten by the pace and the inward turn and is hit on the pads. The tourists appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Rashid looking threatening.
Flatter one on the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Rashid keeps it full on off, McBrine goes back and tries to late cut it. The ball turns into him and takes the bat handle and rolls towards short third man.
Drinks.
Floated one on the off stump line. Rankin gets behind the line well this time and defends confidently.

Leading edge but safe. Nabi keeps it fuler on off. Rankin tries to turn it into the leg side but the ball turns away and takes his leading edge. However the ball rolls down towards the covers region and he is safe.

A quicker and flatter ball on off, lands and skids through, Rankin trying to push it into the off side gets and inside edge and the ball runs down towards the square leg region. They cross over for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, prods forward and defends.

Beaten! Beautiful bowling by Nabi. Tossed up around off, brings the batsman forward who is looking to block it. The ball lands and turn and whizzes past the outside edge. Classic off spin bowling by the experienced campaigner.
Nabi starts with a slower loopy one on the middle and leg line. McBrine goes back and turns it round the corner for a single.
Another leg spinner, Rankin somehow gets his bat down in time and blocks it.
Boyd Rankin, probably the tallest player between the two sides, strides out to bat.

OUT! Plumb in front! 5th LBW of the innings! Rashid Khan gets his third. This was on the cards, wasn't it? He bowling to a tailender, there was only going to be one outcome. He bowls the leg spinner, it pitches around off, turns in and also skids through. Murtagh goes back and tries to defend but is beaten by the pace of the delivery. He is hit on the pads, the players appeal and the umpire immediately raises his finger.
On the shorter side, the batsman pulls it but finds mid-wicket.
On the stumps, kept out.
The googly outside off, Murtagh guides it to point.
Starts off with a leg spinner on middle, the batsman tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
Yes, he will as Rashid Khan is brought back into the attack.

Not Out. Nabi floats this one and keeps it fuller around the off stump. Gets the batsman playing a drive, but McBrine is not to the pitch of the ball. The ball lands and turns away beating the bat. Shahzad whips the bails off quickly and appeals. The umpire goes up to check. Replays show that he had his foot just inside the crease.
An appeal for a stumping has been taken upstairs. McBrine is the man in question. However the visitors don't look that confident.
Keeps it straighter and flatter, McBrine tries to work it into the leg side, gets and inside edge onto his pads. No run on offer.
Floated on middle and off, McBrine lunges and blocks.
Tossed up ball onm middle and leg is turned away into the mid-wicket region for a single.
Beaten! Keeps this o=fuller on off stump and gets it to skid on pitching. Murtagh, who is playing for spin is beaten. He survives.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot.l
Rashid Khan is back onto the field. This is good news for Afghanistan, will he bowl though?
Murtagh tries to turn this length ball into the leg side but gets hit on his pads. The balls rolls down towards the mid-wicket region and they take a single.

Beaten! This is super bowling from the skipper. He keeps it just behind a length on the off stump. The angle across the bats beats Tim's tentative poke. Afghan has his hands on his head. He's expecting another wicket now. Talk about being optimistic.
A bit short of a length, tapped to the point region.
Pulls the length back a bit and lands it on the middle stump line, Murtagh goes back and blocks it out.
Lands it on a length just on off, Tim prods forward and defends.
Tim Murtagh is the next batsman in.

Dream Start! Just cannot get better than this.  Talk about a golden arm, this is platinum. Afghan lands the first one on a length on the middle stump line. The ball hits the surface and moves into the batsman as he is looking to keep it out from his crease. The movement in has beaten the inside edge and hits him in front. A loud appeal follows, the umpire think for a couple of seconds and then raises his finger. And the Afghanistan captain now is into the wickets column.
The skipper, Asghar Afghan comes into the attack.
Keeps it a bit slower outside off, Wilson goes back and taps it towards point for another run.
Flatter and fuller on middle, he flicks it to mid-wicket for an easy single.
Slower and fuller on the off stump, Wilson leans forward and drives it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up on the middle stump line, Wilson waits for the ball and defends with a straight bat.
Gets a bit straighter this time and is flicked into the mid-wicket region for a single.
A Beauty from Nabi! Tosses this up and lands it around the off stump line. McBrine steps forward and the ball spins past the bat, lovely delivery from Nabi there. McBrine survives.
Another quick bouncer on middle, Wilson transfers his weight onto the back foot and pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Slower ball outside off, AM slaps it through covers for a run.
Another bumper, McBrine tries to pull but gets an inside edge to the keeper.
Short again on middle, McBrine guides it to point.
Bends his back on this one and bowls it on the shorter side, it pitches and shoots off the surface. McBrine tries to tuck it around the corner but the ball hits his glove and goes towards point.
On a length and around off, Wilson taps it towards cover-point and takes a run. The two are really going well here. They are not getting the boundaries but are rotating the strike well.
Tossed up on the off stump line, comes forward and defends.
Keeps it a bit slower ans shorter, is punched into the covers region for a single.
Goes back to this skidder on off and taps it into the leg side for a single.
Fuller on the stumps is worked away towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, is defended off the front foot.
Slower and floated outside off, McBrine goes back and punches through the covers for a single.
Alam keeps it a bit short again. McBrine pulls but does not get it from the middle and gets a single towards the square leg region.
A short of a length ball on the pads, flicked away towards square leg for a single.

Rashid Khan seems to be in some pain after his fielding effort on the last delivery. The physio is out now, having a look at him. Rashid now, is back onto his feet but is seen walking off the field gingerly. Afghanistan would hope it is nothing serious.

Bangs it a bit shorter, McBrine picks up the length early, goes back, swivels and pulls it towards the square leg region. Rashid, fielding at deep mid-wicket, runs across, slides and stops it from going across the ropes. Good fielding but it seems like he has hurt himself while sliding. Hope he is alright.
Gets right behind the line of this short of a length delivery on the stumps and keeps it out.
On a length around off, angling in, it's blocked out.
Starts off a new spell by landing it on a length outside off from around the wicket, the angle in is taken into account and McBrine defends off the front foot.
Aftab Alam comes back into the attack.
McBrine goes back to the slower delivery outside off and punches it into the cover region for a single.
A bit shorter around off, McBrine goes back and blocks.
Slower and full on off, defends solidly.
A similar ball but this time on the right hander's pads who flicks this one away into the square leg region for a single.
Floats it full on the stumps, McBrine comes forward and works it into the leg side for a single.
Slower through the air outside off, it is tapped towards the point region.
Comes forward and defends this fuller ball on off.
Wide! Tries to flick this one off his pads but the angle takes it further down the leg side. Signaled a wide.
Beaten. Rashid keeps it outside off, Wilson tries to get bat on ball but is beaten by the spin away from him.
Tossed up on middle, driven through mid on for a single.
Quicker and flatter by Khan just outside off, McBrine goes for the cut and gets beaten.
Seeing the ball a bit shorter, Wilson goes back and punches it through cover-point for a single.
Floated around off, flicked towards mid-wicket.

Leading edge and safe again! McBrine almost pays the price of playing across the line. Nabi floats it up on middle, it pitches and stops on the surface. McBrine tries to flick but gets a leading edge which lobs towards covers. Rashid runs in but can't get to it.
Loopy ball on the stumps, AM strokes it to covers.
On the stumps, defended.
On the shorter side outside off, Wilson cuts it through cover-point and takes a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Wilson lunges and keeps it out.
Fires it on off, Wilson pushes it to covers.
Tossed up delivery pushed towards covers for a single.

2 Wides! That's a rare mistake by the champion leggie. He changes the side and comes around the wicket, fires this one into McBrine. The ball lands and turns further in, misses McBrine's thigh pads and the keeper stops it from going behind but cannot collect it cleanly. They run  for this wide.
McBrine gets right behind this straight delivery and keeps it out.
Tossed up full on the off stump, comes forward and flicks it to mid-wicket.
This time Wilson does not miss his whip and hits it towards the square leg region for a single.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.

Big Appeal for an LBW but turned down. Khan keeps it a bit short on off, Wilson goes back and tries to whip it into the leg side, gets beaten by pace and is struck on the pads. The hosts appeal half-heartedly, umpire rejects.
Similar ball to the last one and similarly blocked.
Tossed up around off is defended off the front foot.
Beaten! Keeps it full on off. Pitches and goes straight. McBrine playing for the spin is beaten.
Straighter one on the stumps, flicked away for a single to square leg.

FOUR! Clever shot by Wilson. Nabi fires this a bit quicker and shorter outside the off stump line, Wilson opens the face of his bat at the last moment and glides it down to third man. The pace on the ball is enough to carry it across the ropes.

Nabi starts from around the wicket, keeps it full on the off stump line. The ball pitches and skids through. Wilson tries to block but fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad. A strong appeal from the bowler and the fielders. The umpire shows no interest in the appeal.
Mohammad Nabi comes into the attack.
A bit short and straight, Wilson rocks back and turns it into the leg side towards the square leg region and takes a single.
Tossed up on off, kept out off the front foot.
Khan fires this one a bit quicker on the off stump line, Wilson keeps this one out with a straight bat.
A bit on the shorter side, Wilson stays inside the crease and defends.
Tossed up on off, kept out off the back foot.

Good running. Rashid bowls it fuller on the middle stump line. Wilson comes forward and works it into the mid-wicket area. The batsman sense the opportunity of a second, calls for it and completes it easily.

No McBrine, it is never a good idea to play against the turn. He got away with it there. Mujeeb bowls the offie on middle, the batsman tries to work it through the leg side but gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
Punches it through covers and takes a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another misfield! Afghanistan have not been at their best on the field today. Flatter outside off, McBrine guides it towards point. The fielder there misfields and a run is taken.
Flighted ball outside off, Wilson strokes it through the off side and gets to the other end.
Loopy ball outside off, Wilson leans into it and hits it back to the bowler.
Tossed up straight, McBrine defends well.
Lands a bit short, spinning into the batsman. McBrine is beaten and is struck on the thigh pad. The fielding side is asking the question. The Umpire shows no interest in the appeal though.
A bit shorter in length on the middle stump line, McBrine blocks it off the front foot.
Keeps it fuller on the off stump, Andy comes forward and defends.

Lands this flatter one around the middle and leg stump. McBrine stays in his crease and tries to block it out. The ball spins in and raps him on the pads. The hosts appeal loud but the umpire this time shake his head sideways. Replay show that there was a faint inside edge, which may have saved the southpaw. Rashid applying immense pressure.
Andy McBrine walks in next.

OUT! The dangerman strikes again! The No. 1 bowler of the visiting team, a world class leg spinner, delivers what is expected from him. Tosses up a googly just outside off. It pitches and turns in. Singh, prods forward and tries to defend but is beaten by the spin. The ball raps the front pad. Rashid goes up instantly and the umpire, after taking a couple of seconds, gives him the marching order.
Keeps it a bit shorter, Wilson defends with a straight bat.
Rahman strays on the pads, Singh goes back and works this around the corner for a single.
Gets right behind this one on the off stump line. Singh blocks it out.
Tosses this one fuller on the stumps, kept out by the batsman.
A short leg in place.
A similar delivery is blocked off the front foot by Singh.
Mujeeb starts off after the break with a one on the stumps, defended by Simi Singh.
Drinks!
Gary Wilson is the next man in. This is his 99th ODI.

OUT! Boom! Rashid Khan strikes on the last ball of his first over! What a champion bowler he is. Gets the big fish, if there is one in this Ireland side. Once again it is the googly which does the trick for him. It it pitched outside off, it turns back in. O'Brien plants his front foot across and tries to flick. He misses and is hit right in front. The players appeal and the umpire agrees. Ireland have not even crossed the 100-run mark and they have lost half their side already. Ominous signs these!
Singh pushes this towards the off side and gets to the other end.

The googly almost does the trick. It is pitched outside off and it comes in. Simi Singh prods forward and tries to block. He does not pick it at all. He misses the ball, it hits the pads and the players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Impact outside off.
Very full again, Kevin drives it crisply through covers for a run.
A little too full, Kevin pushes it back to the bowler.
Not the ideal start by Rashid. Slightly short outside off, Simi punches it through covers and takes a run.
Rashid Khan is into the attack. Afghan here is going in for the kill.

FOUR! Second boundary of the over! A very good one for Ireland. Naib is not learning here. He again bangs it short and it is too easy for Kevin. He pulls it through square leg. No fielder in the deep and a boundary results.
Pulls it again, in the gap again. Not off the middle though but timed well enough by the batsmen to get three.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Down the leg side, Singh tries to flick but misses. Shahzad dives to make a good half stop. Wide signaled.

FOUR! Crunched! That made a cracking sound of the bat! A bumper on middle, trying to catch the batsman off guard. However, Simi is upto the task, he swivels and pulls it through square leg and the ball races away.
Good length again on off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
On a length around off, Kevin taps it towards covers and gets to the other end. The fielder there does have a shy but misses.
On the pads, the batsman tucks it to the leg side. Shahzad appeals but he is the only one doing so.
Floats it up on off, it is driven to covers,
Flatter on off, the batsman punches it down to long on for a run.
On the stumps, kept out.
On middle, KOB works it to short fine leg.
FOUR! Up and over! Trademark Kevin. It was in his zone. Tossed up on off, again a little too full. O'Brien lofts it over mid off and the ball races away. He needs to stay there, holds the key now.
A short leg in place. Afghanistan on the attack here.
On off, guided to point.

FOUR! Very, very poor by Rashid. Not something you expect from him. It is short and outside off, Simi punches it towards point. Rashid there slides but lets the ball through and the ball races away. 50 up for Ireland but they have lost 4 wickets.
Very full on off, Singh drives it square on the off side but finds point.
Nice shot! Shorter in length on off, Singh stands tall and punches it through covers for a brace.
Back of a length on off, Kevin plays a short-arm jab towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a length around off, Kevin prods forward and blocks it.
Loopy ball on off, Singh pushes it to mid off. A maiden by Mujeeb.
Oh! This is quicker on off, it pitches and stays a touch low. Singh does really well to get his bat down in time.
Very full this time, the turn is out of contention. Singh drives it to mid off.
Better! He tosses this up on off, the batsman keeps it out.
A touch too short by Mujeeb, he has been regularly on that length today. Too easy for Singh to go back and keep it out.
Flatter on off, the batsman defends it off the back foot.

FOUR! Super start by Kevin. Naib pulls the length back just a bit, the hefty right-hander sees the length early, rocks back and punches it through the cover-point region. The timing is supreme and the ball races across. Two wickets followed by a boundary to end an eventful over.
Kevin O'Brien is the next batsman in.

OUT! It had to be a peach to get this in-form batsman. Naib is the one who comes up with it. Lands this one a bit short of full length and a bit wide of the off stump line. Entices Andy into the drive who takes the bait. The ball pitches and nips away ever so slightly and takes the outside edge. Mohammad Shahzad behind pouches it and jumps in joy. The tourists get the man in form.
Defends this length ball on the stumps off the front foot.
Keeps it a bit shorter of a length, Simi stays back, opens the face of his bat and runs it down to the third man region. They run a single.
Naib keeps it on a length just outside off, Simi Singh watchfully leaves.
Simi Singh walks out to the middle.

OUT! Gulbadin strikes and the change of ends works. He fires in a length ball angled into Niall from around the wicket. The southpaw tries to come forward and push it straight down the ground. However, he's beaten as the ball lands and nips in further and raps him on his front pad. A big appeal follows and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. It looked very close to the naked eye. The length was the key there as it did not allow the batsman to either come forward or go back. He was stuck in his crease and could not cope with the movement either. Gulbadin takes his second and the hosts lose their fourth.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Gulbadin Naib is back on.

Lovely, lovely stuff! Slower through the air outside off, it is the offie from Rahman. Andy lunges and tries to drive but the ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and goes into the hands of Shahzad.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
With the angle works it to mid-wicket.
Swept and swept nicely through square leg for a run.

Misfield and some extra runs! Fires it on off, Balbirnie tries to punch it through the off side but gets an outside edge towards short third man. Afghan there dives over the ball and the batsmen run two.
Flatter on off, Andy blocks it out.
Niall O'Brien is the new man in. Also Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back into the attack.

OUT! In the air... dropped, no taken! Afghan hangs onto it, not on the first, not on the second but on the third attempt to send his opposite number back. Huge wicket and Ireland now have both the openers back in the hut. Alam gets his second. He bowls it just ahead of a length from wide of the crease. Porterfield who has been driving on the up quite often, tries to do the same. This time though he hits it uppishly and does not find the gap. It goes towards Asghar at mid off who tries to catch it reverse cup but the ball pops out, tries to take it on the second attempt but it again pops out. He then dives and takes it one-handed. Throws the ball onto the ground in anger. A timely wicket as this partnership was building into a promising one.
Back of a length on off, Porterfield stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
Good length outside off, Porterfield slaps it hard but finds covers.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On middle, Porterfield pushes it to mid on.
Slightly straighter on middle, Balbirnie shuffles across and flicks it through mid-wicket for another three. A lot of threes have been taken till now.
A huge shout again but the umpire stays put! Full and outside off, this one comes back in late. William gets his front foot outside off and tries to drive but misses to get hit on the pads.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
On the fuller side, no swing at all for the bowler. He is driven to mid off.
On the shorter side, Porterfield cuts it towards cover-point. A scoring opportunity goes abegging there. It was there to be cut through the gap.
From around the wicket, he bangs it just behind a length and it is defended.
Just behind a fuller length on off, Porterfield drives it to mid off.
Length around middle, William tries to block but it goes off the inner half towards fine leg for a run.
Tucks it through mid-wicket with the angle for a run. Looking good is Balbirnie again.
Slightly fuller and Porterfield pounces onto it. He times it through covers and runs three.
Changes the angle and comes over the wicket and bowls a good nut! On off and it shapes away from the left-hander. Porterfield plays inside the line and lets it go through.
Better! Back of a length on off, Porterfield punches it to mid off.
FOUR LEG BYES! Raining boundaries now! Poor line by Alam. He strays it on the pads, William tries to flick but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes down to the fine leg fence.
Outside off, left alone. So two dots to end a good over for Ireland. 9 from it.
On off, kept out. Dragged his length back a little this time.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Naib has not had a good start with the ball. He again bowls it very full on the stumps this time. Balbirnie helps himself and times it through mid on. The ball races away.
FOUR! Classic! Very full and outside off, Andy is in too good a form to miss out there, he strokes it through covers and bags a boundary.

Leading edge but safe! A little too straight by Naib. Porterfield tries to flick it but closes the face of his bat a touch early. Maybe he was expecting the ball to come a touch quicker but it does not. It takes the leading edge and lobs back over the bowler's head for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gulbadin Naib is into the attack.
On the stumps again, AB pushes it to mid on. Another good over by Alam comes to an end. He has gone for only 7 in his three overs and taken a wicket also.

OHHHH! Close shave! Alam bowls it a touch fuller on off, Balbirnie strokes it back towards the bowler. He gets a hand to it as the ball goes agonizingly close past the stumps at the non-striker's end. William Porterfield gets back in with a dive. However, replays show had that hit the stumps, WP would have just about made it.
Outside the off stump, Balbirnie shoulders arms to it.
Once again nicely driven on the up through wide mid off. However, it does not get to the ropes but the batsmen get three.

Howzzat? The answer to that question is not out! Height an issue and replays later show it pitched outside leg. Shorter around leg. Porterfield goes for the pull but misses it. He is hit high on the pads.
A length ball outside off, Porterfield does not play at it.
Floats it up in search of some purchase. The ball is a little too full though. Andy gets to the pitch of it and pushes it to covers. Another tight over by an Afghan bowler comes to an end.
Attacks the stumps, AB defends it to mid on.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Errs in line this time and bowls it on the pads, Porterfield tucks it around the corner and takes one.
Stump-to-stump line by Mujeeb. William lunges and blocks it.
Fires it on the stumps, Balbirnie pushes it down to long on and takes a run.
The man in form is off the mark. He tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end. End of a successful over by Alam. A run and a wicket from it.
BEATEN! Balbirnie goes fishing to a ball outside off, he probably could have left it. Luckily for him though, it whizzes past the outside edge.
Just behind a length on off, this one keeps a touch low, Andy gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Once again in the corridor of uncertainty. AB rocks back and keeps it out.
Andy Balbirnie is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Alam draws first blood and it is a well deserved wicket. He has been really good till now and he has got his reward. He lands it on a length around off, Stirling has to play at it. He is half-forward as he tries to keep it out. The ball straightens, kisses the outside edge and goes into the mitts of the keeper. Alam is pumped up and he seems to be watching a lot of football as he brings out the Ronaldo celebration. The dangerous Paul Stirling walks back cheaply, not the start Ireland would have wanted after winning the toss and opting to bat.
Good start to his second over! Good length on off, this one pitches and shapes away. Paul tries to defend but is hit high on the glove.
A dot to end! Not a lot of purchase for Rahman in his first over. He bowls this flatter on off, Porterfield keeps it out easily.
The slider on the pads, Porterfield works it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! First boundary and it is off the bat of the Irish skipper. Top shot this! Rahman bowls it a touch too full and pays the price. He is crisply driven through covers and the ball races away to the fence.
A little too full, Porterfield strokes it to mid off.
On off, William lunges and blocks it out.
Fires it on the pads, no turn for him on the first delivery. Porterfield tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl from the other end.
Off the mark is Stirling with that confident punch. Back of a length outside off, Paul guides it through backward point and runs two. A good first over by Alam comes to an end.

Edged but wide of second slip! So after two wayward deliveries, Alam has really come back well. Once again uses the angle very well. Pitches it on off and then gets to slant away. William tries to block it but the ball takes the outside edge and goes down to third man. The batsmen cross. Also, first run for Ireland in this game.
Uppish but safe! On a length again around off, Porterfield tries to stroke it on the up, he does so uppishly but well short of cover-point.

A huge shout by the bowler but nothing from the umpire. Alam gets this one on the money and it almost produces a wicket. Excellent use of the angle there, on a length and around off, this one pitches and angles away. Porterfield tries to defend but he seems to have been beaten.
